move.instructions: Read the handwritten target digit in the image. Choose exactly one operation that moves the current number toward it. Choose 0 only when equal.

criteria.-1: Subtract one from the current number.
criteria.0: Keep the current number and STOP: already equal to the image digit.
criteria.+1: Add one to the current number.
